full_text_zh:
[P1] 妈妈
你
好吗？
后藤龙二 文 武田美穗 图
蒲蒲兰 译

[P2] 妈妈
你好
吗？
后藤龙二 文
武田美穗 图
萧萧兰 译

[P3] 妈妈你好！我很好哦。母亲节快要到了，我现在需要给你写封信。
“给妈妈写封信表达谢意吧！”老师很得意她想出这个主意，我只好努力地写。
同桌的勇介写了些“谢谢你天天给我做饭”，我说不出这种话来，我说我想说的吧。
很像……

[P4] 第一个要说的：就是你的口头禅，不管说什么，你最后总是会加上：“明白了没有？”
“路上小心，明白了没有？上课别跟阿香聊天，明白了没有？不要拽勇介的头发，明白了没有？”
今天早上在门口，你就说了好几遍。
勇介和阿香就在旁边，我赶紧忙着答应，心里实在有点难为情。

[P5] 妈妈，我已经上小学四年级，不再是小宝宝了。
你不说“明白了没有？”我也明白，不用担心。
我不会上课聊天。以前是聊过，最近没有啦。
天天学踢球、空手道，还有钢琴和英语，我太累了。
一进教室我就趴在桌上。
我最近根本没拽过勇介的头发。一个星期前，我闹着
玩，拉了一下，谁知过了两天，他突然剃光了头发，现在，
我就是有时候摸摸。

[P6] 所以，妈妈，你真的不用担心。明白了没有？
小央，醒醒！

[P7] 第二个想说的：不要整天说我的房间“像猪圈”，不经我的同意请别打扫我的房间！
我不是猪，是人！
你喜欢房间整整齐齐，可我习惯乱七八糟。要是房间里太干净太整齐了，我会有点不自在的。东西堆得满满的，房间里很多我的宝贝，我才会快乐。

[P8] 去年冬天那件事还记得吗？你说一句“简直是垃圾堆”，就把我的宝贝通通扔掉了。
真气人啊！我一个多星期都没理你。
妈妈，你大概不记得了，我可记着呢。

[P9] 那张乱糟糟的画，是我的恐龙系列，幼儿园时画的。那时勇介他们老往我头上撒沙子。我躲起来一边画一边哭。在画里我很厉害，“嗷呜——”，嘴里喷出火焰。
是恐龙！
什么破蜥蜴！
嗷呜

[P10] 那块蓝色的石头是阿香送给我的。
我一年级时爱哭鼻子，那天被阿香欺负，
我哭了一整天。“真能哭啊，这是你的奖品。”
说着她递给我一块蓝色的石头。
哭，还得了奖励。
不过，从那以后，我就不怎么哭了。

[P11] 那双破破烂烂的运动鞋，是去年运动会时穿的。50米赛跑
我第一次赢了勇介。
我恨不得每次跑步都穿着那双鞋，可惜后来穿不下了……

那个长颈鹿玩具，是圣诞老人送的礼物。那时我是个小宝宝，
爸爸也还在家。
我整天咬呀啃呀，它的脖子都快断了，还发了霉，难道你不知道我特别宝贝它吗？
发霉了，可以洗一洗。发霉的年糕削掉了霉，我们不也吃了吗？
干吗要扔掉呀？太过分啦！

[P12] 那个满是虫眼的橡子，是我最最不想扔掉的！
二年级那个厉害的班主任，你记得吧？
忘了带什么东西，或者回答不出问题，他马上就
发火，动不动罚我们站着听课。
有一次，我怕被罚，躲进了学校后山。那天，你过来找我，连班也没上。
我以为你肯定会骂我，没想到你没有生气，一边说着
“锐鑫很漂亮啊”，一边和我一起捡橡子。
就是那次捡的橡子呀！

[P13] 坏妈妈
旷工了
逃课了
坏孩子

[P14] 回家的路上，你买了根冰棍儿，我们俩你一口我一口
轮流吃，那根小棍我也一直好好留着……
这个那个，一下子全没了。
说也没用，已经找不回来了。
后来我又收集了各种各样的宝贝，没那么伤心了。
以后你能不能别管我，我的房间让我自己作主。

[P15] 啊，对了，妈妈，你叮叮当当地做饭，哗啦哗啦地
洗衣服，一边跟我说“带齐东西没有”，一边蹬蹬蹬地踩
着高跟鞋，飞快地上班去。阿香崇拜你，说：“真了不起
啊！”不过，你也别太着急了，穿着高跟鞋摔跤，那可不
得了。

[P16] 不好意思，零花钱快花光了，我现在是个穷光蛋，
只能送你一朵康乃馨，还有一打洗碗券。
节日快乐，妈妈！

[P18] 一天只能用一张
洗碗券
一天只能用一张
洗碗券
一天只能用一张
洗碗券
full_text_en:
[P1] Mom
You
Okay?
Text by Ryūji Goto, Illustrations by Mihoko Takeda
Translated by Pupulan

[P2] Mom
Hello
Right?
Ryuji Goto Text
Mihoko Takeda Illustrations
Xiao Xiao Lan Translator

[P3] Hi Mom! I'm doing well. Mother's Day is coming up, and I need to write you a letter.
"Let's write a letter to Mom to express our gratitude!" The teacher was very proud of coming up with this idea, so I had to try my best to write.
My classmate Yuusuke wrote, "Thank you for cooking for me every day," but I can't say things like that. I'll write what I want to say.
Looks like...

[P4] The first thing to say: it's your catchphrase. No matter what you say, you always end with, 'Got it?' 
'Be careful on your way, got it? Don't chat with A-xiang in class, got it? Don't pull Yuujie's hair, got it?' 
This morning at the door, you said it several times. 
Yuujie and A-xiang were right there, and I hurriedly kept answering, feeling really embarrassed inside.

[P5] Mom, I've already started fourth grade in elementary school. I'm not a little baby anymore.
You don't need to say 'Do you understand?' I understand, don't worry.
I don't talk during class anymore. I did before, but not lately.
I'm always learning soccer, karate, piano, and English. I'm so tired.
As soon as I enter the classroom, I lie down on the desk.
I haven't pulled Yuusuke's hair at all recently. A week ago, I was just playing around and pulled it once. But two days later, he suddenly shaved his head. Now, I just sometimes touch it.

[P6] So, Mom, you really don't need to worry. Do you understand?
Xiao Yang, wake up!

[P7] The second thing I want to say: Don't always say my room is 'like a pigsty'. Please don't clean my room without my permission!
I'm not a pig, I'm a human!
You like your room neat and tidy, but I'm used to being messy. If the room is too clean and tidy, I feel a bit uncomfortable. When it's full of stuff, with lots of my treasures, that's when I'm happy.

[P8] Do you remember that thing from last winter? You said, 'It's just a trash heap,' and threw away all my treasures.
How annoying! I didn't talk to you for over a week.
Mom, you probably don't remember, but I do.

[P9] That messy drawing is my dinosaur series, drawn when I was in kindergarten. Back then, Yuusuke and the others always threw sand on my head. I would hide and draw while crying. In the drawing, I was very powerful, 'Roar—', with flames spewing from my mouth.
It's a dinosaur!
What a lousy lizard!
Roar

[P10] That blue stone was given to me by Axiang.
I used to cry a lot in first grade. That day, I was bullied by Axiang,
and I cried all day. "You really can cry! Here's your reward."
She said, handing me a blue stone.
Crying, and still getting a reward.
But after that, I didn't cry much anymore.

[P11] Those worn-out running shoes were the ones I wore at last year's sports day. In the 50-meter race, I won for the first time against Yuusuke.
I wished I could wear those shoes every time I ran, but sadly, I couldn't fit into them anymore...

That giraffe toy was a gift from Santa Claus. Back then, I was still a little baby, and Dad was still at home.
I chewed on it all day long. Its neck is almost broken, and it's even moldy. Don't you know how much I treasure it?
If it's moldy, you can just wash it. We eat moldy mochi after scraping off the mold, don't we?
Why throw it away? That's too unfair!

[P12] That acorn full of bug holes is the one I never want to throw away!
Remember that strict homeroom teacher from second grade?
If we forgot something or couldn't answer a question, he'd get angry and make us stand in class.
Once, afraid of being punished, I hid in the school's back hill. That day, you came to find me, and I missed class.
I thought you'd scold me, but you didn't get angry. Instead, you said, 'Rui Xin is so beautiful,' and picked acorns with me.
That's the acorn we picked that day!

[P13] Bad mom
Skipped work
Skipped school
Bad kid

[P14] On the way home, you bought an ice pop, and we took turns eating it, one bite at a time.
I kept that little stick carefully all along...
This and that, all gone in an instant.
It's no use saying anything; they're already lost.
Later, I collected all sorts of treasures again, and I wasn't as sad anymore.
Can you please stop interfering? Let me be in charge of my own room.

[P15] Ah, right, Mom, you clatter and clang while cooking, splash and splash while washing clothes, and while saying to me, 'Did you bring everything?', you tap-tap-tap your high heels and rush off to work quickly. Ah-ah admires you, saying, 'You're really amazing!' But, you shouldn't be in such a hurry—falling over in high heels would be terrible.

[P16] Sorry, I've almost spent all my allowance. I'm a poor kid now,
so I can only give you one carnation and a bunch of dishwashing coupons.
Happy holiday, Mom!

[P18] One can only use one per day
Dishwashing Voucher
One can only use one per day
Dishwashing Voucher

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 绘本封面展示了一个小男孩和一个女性角色，中间大字写着“妈妈，你好吗？”，下方标注了作者、绘者和译者信息。
[P2] 画面展示了一只手正在纸上用彩色笔书写“妈妈，你好吗？”的文字，旁边标注了作者、绘者和译者信息。
[P3] 小男孩在母亲节前被老师要求给妈妈写感谢信，他感到为难，因为同桌写的是“谢谢你天天给我做饭”，而他想写自己真正想说的话。画面中他正在纸上画妈妈，觉得画得“很像……”，同时脸上露出纠结和害羞的表情。
[P4] 小男孩回忆妈妈每天早上送他上学时，总爱用“明白了没有？”作为口头禅，让他在同学面前感到难为情。
[P5] 小男孩在信中告诉妈妈自己已经上四年级，不再需要她反复确认是否明白，并描述了自己忙碌的学习生活和对同学勇介头发变化的关心。
[P6] 小男孩在课堂上睡着了，老师叫他‘小央，醒醒！’，而他心里想着对妈妈说的话：‘所以，妈妈，你真的不用担心。明白了没有？’
[P7] 小男孩在信中告诉妈妈，他不喜欢别人说他的房间像猪圈，也不希望妈妈未经允许打扫他的房间，因为他习惯于杂乱，并在充满自己宝贝的房间里感到快乐。
[P8] 小男孩回忆起去年冬天妈妈说他房间是‘垃圾堆’并扔掉他心爱物品的事，感到生气并一个多星期没理妈妈，至今仍记得这件事。
[P9] 小男孩回忆起幼儿园时画恐龙画被同学嘲笑的经历，他为自己画的恐龙辩护，而同学则嘲笑画中的恐龙是‘破蜥蜴’，画面展现了他当时愤怒和委屈的情绪。
[P10] 小男孩回忆起一年级时因爱哭被同学阿香欺负，阿香却送他一块蓝色石头作为‘奖品’，从此他不再轻易哭泣。
[P11] 小男孩回忆起自己珍爱的破旧运动鞋和长颈鹿玩具，表达了对这些旧物的情感，以及对妈妈可能丢弃它们的担忧和不满。
[P12] 小男孩回忆起二年级时因害怕被严厉的班主任惩罚而躲进学校后山，妈妈找到他后没有责骂，反而和他一起捡橡子，让他珍视那次捡到的虫眼橡子。
[P13] 小男孩和妈妈在户外奔跑，两人互相喊着‘坏妈妈’‘旷工了’‘逃课了’‘坏孩子’，画面充满童趣和欢乐，展现了母子间轻松调皮的互动。
[P14] 小男孩回忆起和妈妈一起吃冰棍的往事，表达了对童年物品丢失的遗憾，以及希望妈妈尊重他房间自主权的愿望。画面描绘了母子在夕阳下奔跑的温馨场景。
[P15] 小男孩回忆妈妈忙碌的早晨，她一边做饭洗衣服，一边催促他带齐东西，穿着高跟鞋匆忙上班，阿香崇拜妈妈，男孩也提醒妈妈别太着急以免摔倒。
[P16] 小男孩在母亲节当天，因零花钱花光，只能送妈妈一朵康乃馨和一打洗碗券作为礼物，并送上节日祝福，画面右侧是孩子画的贺卡，上面有妈妈的卡通形象和“谢谢！”字样。
[P17] 画面中，妈妈坐在桌前，低头看着一张纸，桌上放着一朵花和一张卡片，背景为温暖的黄色光晕，表现出她收到礼物后的感动与沉思。
[P18] 画面展示了多张手写的‘洗碗券’，每张券上都写着‘一天只能用一张’，右下角有一只握着绿色笔的小手正在书写，暗示这是孩子为母亲节准备的礼物之一。
